The '''FLLA''' is the international governing body of [[wikipedia:association football|association football]]. It is composed of seven continental confederations: [[NFLA]] ([[Atirha]]), [[AFLA]] ([[Ayuma]]), [[NAFLA]] ([[New Ayre]]), [[EFLA]] ([[Mahea]]), [[QFLA]] ([[Quia]]), [[MFLA]] ([[Massir]]) and [[CFLA]] ([[Acrola]]).

The FLLA organises the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international association football tournament. The most recent edition was the [[1764 FLLA World Cup]], won by [[Easuhura]].
